local_articles.title: Why Kylian Mbappe leads Lionel Messi in Golden Boot race despite both scoring the same number of goals
local_articles.snippet: In a game dominated by physical battles and simmering tempers over more than 100 minutes in Philadelphia, Kylian Mbappe made the decisive impact. The France captain converted from the penalty spot in the 70th minute against Paraguay in the FIFA World Cup Round of 16 to seal a 1-0 win and book Les Bleus' quarterfinal clash against Morocco next Thursday in Boston. {{^htLoading}} {{/htLoading}} The goal was Mbappé's 19th in World Cup history from just 19 appearances, leaving him one strike away from equalling Lionel Messi's all-time tournament record. Messi had become the first player to score 20 World Cup goals after netting against Cape Verde in Argentina's 3-2 Round of 32 win earlier this week, overtaking Miroslav Klose in the process. questions.title: Which national team will win the third-place playoff at the 2026 FIFA Men's World Cup?
questions.background: The third-place playoff is contested by the two teams eliminated in the semifinals.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : FIFA's official result for the 2026 Men's World Cup third-place playoff. Resolution : Resolve to the winner of the third-place playoff, scheduled for July 18, 2026, including extra time or a penalty shootout if required. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the winning country.

Remaining 38.5% covers Portugal (~7.0%), Morocco (~6.6%), Colombia (~5.8%), Switzerland, Norway, Mexico, USA, Belgium, and Egypt.
